plugins.description: Send email from any app with MailChannels Email API: password resets, sign-in links, receipts, invitations and notifications. REST or SMTP, official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, Laravel, Symfony and Nodemailer transports, signed delivery webhooks, and sub-accounts when your users or agents send through your app. Free to start.
